title: Prevent order matching for invoice lines created by Get Receipt Lines
summary: Matched order line functionality now rejects invoice lines created through Get Receipt Lines, preventing inconsistent matching information when working with similar purchase orders.
key_points: CheckLineCanBeMatched validation blocks matching attempts on lines with a populated Receipt No. field
Guard enforced at both per-line entry points (page drill-down, action) and header-opened paths (codeunit functions)
Error message immediately informs users that matched order lines aren't supported for Get Receipt Lines-created lines
Test coverage includes both per-line and header-path rejection scenarios
quote: Matched order lines are not supported for lines created with the Get Receipt Lines function.
